_why: Skill-candidates row `run every published expect 0 screen at the freeze sha before certifying "no census moved"` (#49w), plus the fresh-context review of 5cba8c6b. h_mad_expect_screens.py reads each document from the working tree, finds every statement in a bash/sh fence ending `# expect <N>` (quote-, comment- and heredoc-aware boundaries), runs each qualifying block once in a throwaway detached worktree AT the sha with stdin from /dev/null and repository-redirecting GIT_* variables dropped, captures each screen's stdout between markers, and refuses (UNREADABLE, never PASS) a died, repeated or mangled screen, a pipeline member exiting >=2, an earlier recorded failure, or non-integer output. The worktree is removed on every path including SIGTERM, deleting only its own entry. No screen at all is NONE (exit 3), not PASS. Each row breaks one of those properties.

mutations.name: backslash-continuation-ignored
mutations._mechanism: A statement continued by a trailing backslash is split: the begin marker lands inside it.

mutations.name: operator-continuation-ignored
mutations._mechanism: A statement continued by a trailing `|` is split: `cmd | printf <marker>`.

mutations.name: operator-read-past-the-comment

mutations.name: blank-line-ends-the-pipe
mutations._mechanism: Review M1: a blank line after `cmd |` is taken as the end of the statement.

mutations.name: quoted-continuation-ignored
mutations._mechanism: A line that starts inside a multi-line quoted string is taken as a statement start; the marker lands inside the string.

mutations.find: k = lines[j].body if lines[j].body is not None else j
